audit.whatIsWrong: WRONG ABILITY, seven places. The content layer calls the reflect 'her R reflect' throughout — whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.you[2], wants.foe[0] and the early/mid/late blocks. The reflect is Rebuttal (W): a barrier that reflects projectiles, prevents damage and grants move speed, on 38/35/33/29/26s. Golden Eclipse (R) is a global strike that consumes Overwhelm stacks and reflects nothing.
audit.why: The full layer already names Rebuttal correctly, so the page currently tells the reader two different things about the same mechanic. The cooldown difference matters enormously: 38s at rank 1 versus 120s means the counterplay is 'bait it every wave', not 'wait for an ult'.
audit.corrected: Reflect reattributed to Rebuttal (W) with its 38s cooldown in the four places that fit the length band; Golden Eclipse described as the Overwhelm-stack strike it is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 is given to Mel while its why says you open with a free RQ she cannot answer; rows 1-3 and 5 read 'Skill' while their whys describe re-arming faster than her, chunking her off the wave and 'your bullying peak'.
audit.why: Both Qs are 950 (confirmed from the mel__karma side), so the edge is Mantra at level 1, not range. Karma owns 0-3 and 5; 4 is even on the reflect and 6 is her scaling.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Skill in both layers — identical to the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage was written as a Mel spike built on the ult-reflect error.
audit.why: Her ult is 120/100/80s and scales Overwhelm damage; the thing that actually gates your all-in is a 38s W. Restating the stage on the real cooldown changes when you commit.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and spikes[2].text rewritten on Rebuttal's 38s.

edits.before: Her R reflect can bounce your RQ burst and W tether back at you, so the all-in window goes even at 6 — bait the reflect first.
edits.after: Rebuttal (W), not her ult, is the reflect — 38s at rank 1, so bait it with a plain Inner Flame before you commit RQ or the tether.

edits.before: Mel gets her R reflect online — never throw RQ or a W tether into a held reflect, because she can bounce that damage straight back at you.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse hits you anywhere via Overwhelm stacks — and Rebuttal (W), her real reflect, is 38s, so never throw RQ into a held barrier.

edits.before: Bait her R reflect with a plain Inner Flame, then commit RQ + W tether once it is spent
edits.after: Bait Rebuttal (W) with a plain Inner Flame, then commit RQ + tether once it is spent

edits.before: Hold her R reflect to bounce your RQ Soulflare and W-tether damage back into you
edits.after: Hold Rebuttal (W) to bounce your projectiles back and block the damage entirely

edits.before: Win the raw Q-poke exchange and pile her W/E zone on top of your minions
edits.after: Root you with Solar Snare at 1000 range, well outside your 675 tether

notes: The 'her R reflect' error also runs through the content early, mid and late paragraphs, which are too long to rewrite inside the ±10% band without a full re-draft — they still say her ULT reflects. They need a sweep. Also note Rebuttal reflects projectiles, and Inner Flame IS a projectile, so poking into a lit barrier genuinely returns damage; but the same text elsewhere claims it reflects the W tether, which is a targeted tether, not a projectile — I dropped that claim rather than assert either way. Mirror mel__karma is audited and its findings (both Qs 950, Solar Snare 1000 vs tether 675, root is Focused Resolve) are restated from this side.
